# armands.blog

> Personal blog of Armand Viktor Bozsik – computer science graduate (University of Szeged, 2020).
> Bilingual (English / Hungarian). Posts cover IT security, Linux, Windows, how-tos and projects.
> Static site, no tracking, no ads. Accessibility statement: /en/accessibility/ and /hu/accessibility/.

## Content
- English posts: https://armands.blog/en/posts/
- Hungarian posts: https://armands.blog/hu/posts/
- Topics (tags): https://armands.blog/en/tags/ and https://armands.blog/hu/tags/
- About: https://armands.blog/en/about/
- Search index (JSON): https://armands.blog/en/index.json and https://armands.blog/hu/index.json

## Site conventions for agents
- Languages live under /en/ and /hu/; each page declares its lang and links to its translation.
- The site is generated by Hugo from https://gitlab.com/bozsikarmand/armands-blog.
- Theme source: https://gitlab.com/bozsikarmand/hugo-theme-armands-blog
- Contact: hello@armands.site
